Name: Searia04's SVE Fish Retexture (Brighter Version)
Author: Searia04
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This is a partial retexture of the fish added by Stardew Valley Expanded.
Some of them I redrew from scratch; for others I only adjusted the colour palette.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
I made this because I wanted SVE's fish to match DSHi's retexture series. I'm a big fan of that item retexture collection, and while waiting for DSHi's own SVE retexture I put this together as a temporary stand-in.

A few of the fish outlines are based on DSHi's mod 21465. Thank you so much to DSHi for giving me permission to use them[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Download and place it in the Mods folder

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- SMAPI [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Content Patcher [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Stardew Valley Expanded [/color]

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
- Stardew Valley Expanded by FlashShifter

- DSHi's fish retexture: outlines of Diamond Carp, Meteor Carp, Grass Carp,

  Razor Trout, Gemfish and Dulse Seaweed are based on DSHi's sprites,

  used with permission.

  https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21465
